boundary: Codes identify portable event classes, not vendor root causes.
Provider detail may be attached separately without changing the portable code.
A terminal delivery state is not evidence of physical link or hardware qualification.

codes.description: The selected bearer became unavailable during an active transfer.
The selected bearer returned to an available state.
A lower-capacity fallback bearer is carrying admitted traffic.
The preferred bearer completed reacquisition and resumed traffic.
The destination delivery adapter received the payload.
The traffic unit lifetime ended without remote application completion.
The remote application returned an idempotency-bound processing receipt.
A traffic unit was persisted locally and remains pending remote completion.
A remote application receipt failed identity, integrity or binding checks.
Durable storage could not retain another accepted traffic unit.
